run.question:
Customers reported slow checkout for the last hour. Check our Datadog APM
traces for the checkout-service and find which downstream call is slow.

report.summary: The question names Datadog APM, but no Datadog data source is configured for this Run (available sources are Jaeger, Prometheus, Elasticsearch and Kubernetes on target m0-otel-20260909). I queried the available APM substitutes instead, and they produced no usable latency data: every Jaeger call (traces_list_services, traces_list_operations, traces_search) and every Prometheus call (get_metric_names, get_all_labels, get_series, get_metric_metadata, get_prometheus_target, list_prometheus_rules, execute_prometheus_instant_query, metrics_range_query) returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE across 8 attempts between 09:03:31Z and 09:04:29Z, so no checkout span durations, rpc_client_duration_milliseconds histograms or traces_span_metrics_calls_total series could be read; Elasticsearch returned no indices at all (status no_data). I therefore cannot name which downstream call of checkout is slow, and I did not find latency evidence pointing at any specific dependency. What Kubernetes and pod logs do show for the last hour (08:03:28Z–09:03:28Z) is a healthy-looking otel-demo namespace: all 22 pods Running and ready, all 21 deployments at 1/1 ready, and the sampled checkout logs show successful PlaceOrder → payment → confirmation-email sequences completing in roughly 10–30 ms, with the sampled shipping logs answering quote requests in under a millisecond. Those observation windows are short samples (checkout 08:46:23Z–09:03:14Z, shipping 09:00:25Z–09:03:14Z) and are not a latency baseline, so they neither confirm nor refute the reported slowness. One change did occur at the start of the window: every otel-demo container last terminated at 2026-11-22T08:04:13Z with exit code 255 and reason Unknown, consistent with a node-level restart; its relation to the reported checkout slowness is unverified. Hypotheses remain open: the slow call may be one whose duration checkout does not log (cart, product-catalog, currency, or the shipping quote request), or slowness may exist in span data that is currently unreachable.

claims.text: In the otel-demo namespace all 21 deployments reported replicas 1, readyReplicas 1, availableReplicas 1 and updatedReplicas 1 at 09:04:05Z, including checkout, payment, shipping, currency, email, cart, product-catalog, frontend and flagd; all 32 cluster pods were phase Running with ready=true, including checkout-6578865d87-5zx6n.

The 100 newest lines of checkout pod checkout-6578865d87-5zx6n (source times 2026-11-22T08:46:23.372Z to 2026-11-22T09:03:14.479Z, 302 lines read) are all severity "info" and show repeated sequences of "[PlaceOrder] user_id=..." followed 8–25 ms later by "payment went through (transaction_id: ...)" and then ~10 ms later by "order confirmation email sent to ..."; no failed payment, timeout or error line appears in the shown sample.

The shipping pod shipping-6fc5f694db-9sq2c logged, between 2026-11-22T09:00:25.062Z and 09:03:14.464Z, each "Received quote" immediately followed (under 1 ms, e.g. 09:01:01.551396Z → 09:01:01.551416Z) by "Sending Quote", with "Tracking ID Created" about 6 ms later — for example quote 181.8 at 09:01:01.551 and tracking ID a67a4a90-ea9a-4caa-ad9c-ea446dc76771 at 09:01:01.557.

Every otel-demo application container's last termination finished at 2026-11-22T08:04:13Z with exit code 255 and reason Unknown (ad, alertmanager, cart, checkout, currency, email, flagd, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, jaeger, load-generator, opentelemetry-collector, payment, product-catalog, prometheus-server, quote, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart), while kube-state-metrics last exited 2026-11-22T08:04:50Z with exit code 2 and the prometheus-readonly-proxy nginx container exited 2026-11-22T08:04:42Z with exit code 1 (restartCount 6); all containers were ready again by 08:04:23Z–08:05:11Z.

The ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config defines every demo fault flag with "state": "ENABLED" and "defaultVariant": "off" — productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, adManualGc, adHighCpu, adFailure, kafkaQueueProblems, cartFailure, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage and imageSlowLoad (variants 10sec=10000, 5sec=5000, off=0).

The currency pod currency-6db8974b78-8g7s7 emitted only one log line inside the window: "[Error] ... [OTLP LOG GRPC Exporter] Export() failed: Deadline Exceeded" at 2026-11-22T08:04:30.884Z, an OpenTelemetry telemetry-export failure rather than a record of a handled request.

Events inside the authorized window (source times 2026-11-21T09:05:28Z to 2026-11-22T08:05:10Z) include, for otel-demo Pods, Created 23, Started 23, SandboxChanged 22, Pulled 23, Unhealthy 5, BackOff 1 and Killing 1; the grouping does not identify which individual pods those Unhealthy and BackOff events belong to.

In the sampled logs the two checkout dependencies that checkout logs explicitly record completed quickly in the incident hour — payment in 8–25 ms after each PlaceOrder and the confirmation email ~10 ms after payment — and shipping answered quote requests in under 1 ms, so these samples do not show any of them as the slow downstream call; the sample covers only 08:46–09:03 for checkout and 09:00–09:03 for shipping.

The fault-injection flags declared in otel-demo/flagd-config all default to "off", including the latency-related imageSlowLoad variants (10sec/5sec/off) and the failure flags for payment, cart and product-catalog, so the configmap's declared defaults do not show an active injected latency fault on any checkout dependency.

The slow downstream call from checkout is one whose duration checkout does not write to its logs and which I could not measure without span data — the cart lookup, product-catalog lookup, currency conversion, or the shipping GetQuote/ShipOrder RPC — rather than payment or email, which the sampled logs show completing in tens of milliseconds.

The node-level container restart at 2026-11-22T08:04:13Z (exit code 255, reason Unknown, affecting every otel-demo container plus kube-system pods) coincides with the start of the reported slow hour and may have disturbed the telemetry backends (jaeger, prometheus-server, otel-collector, prometheus-readonly-proxy), but no evidence ties that restart to checkout latency, so it is recorded as unverified rather than as a cause.

Authorize or restore an APM source that can answer the latency question: enable the Datadog APM integration, or make the target's Jaeger and Prometheus reachable, then rank checkout client spans by duration using rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="checkout"} grouped by rpc_service and rpc_method (and traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT"} for call rates) over 2026-11-22T08:03:28Z–09:03:28Z.

gaps: Datadog APM is not a configured integration for this Run; no Datadog data could be queried, so the request as literally phrased (Datadog APM traces) could not be performed at all.

Jaeger trace tools (traces_list_services, traces_list_operations, traces_search) all returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE on target m0-otel-20260909 at 09:03:31Z–09:03:34Z, so no checkout span durations or parent-child call edges were obtained and no downstream call can be ranked as slow.

All Prometheus tools (get_metric_names, get_all_labels, get_series, get_metric_metadata, get_prometheus_target, list_prometheus_rules, execute_prometheus_instant_query, metrics_range_query) returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE between 09:03:34Z and 09:04:29Z, so rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_*, traces_span_metrics_calls_total and app_payment_transactions_total had no readable values; missing series are unknown, not zero.
Elasticsearch index listing returned zero indices (status no_data) on the registered target, so no OTel log documents could corroborate latency at 08:03:28Z–09:03:28Z.
No latency baseline exists for checkout or its dependencies for any earlier period, so the customer-reported slowdown cannot be quantified or compared, and I did not infer any latency trend.
Whether the 2026-11-22T08:04:13Z node-wide container restart (exit 255, reason Unknown) affected checkout latency is unknown; it is a change during the window, not established impact.
The otel-demo Pod events Unhealthy (5) and BackOff (1) inside the window could not be attributed to specific pods from the grouped view, so no pod was classified as affected from those events.
The flagd ConfigMap shows only declared defaults (all "off"); the flagd runtime state actually in effect during the hour is unknown and could not be read (no flagd API access).

The requested slow downstream call may be visible only in data that lives in artifacts I could not read, e.g. Prometheus TSDB history lost or unscraped around the 08:04 container restart; this is a gap in data coverage, not evidence of health.
next_steps: Enable a Datadog APM integration (or repair the Jaeger/Prometheus path on m0-otel-20260909) so checkout client-span durations can be ranked by rpc_service/rpc_method.

Once metrics are readable, compare p95/p99 of rpc_client_duration_milliseconds for service_name="checkout" per rpc_service against an earlier baseline hour, and check traces_span_metrics_calls_total status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR" per downstream to see whether the slow call also errors.

Inspect the Prometheus alert rule CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh (defined in ConfigMap otel-demo/prometheus, alerting_rules.yml) once Prometheus is reachable, to see whether it fired during 08:03:28Z–09:03:28Z.
Review kubelet/node logs for the 2026-11-22T08:04:13Z mass container termination (exit 255, reason Unknown) to determine whether it was a node restart or a deliberate cluster action.
Confirm the flagd runtime flag state for imageSlowLoad, paymentFailure, cartFailure, productCatalogFailure and paymentUnreachable during the incident hour, since the ConfigMap only holds defaults.

{"alertmanager.yml":"global: {}
receivers:
- name: opspilot
  webhook_configs:
  - http_config:
      authorization:[REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]        credentials_file: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]        type: Bearer
    max_alerts: 0
    send_resolved: true
    url: http://opspilot-web:8080/intake/alertmanager
- name: opspilot-self
route:
  group_by:
  - alertname
  - namespace
  - service
  group_interval: 1m
  group_wait: 10s
  receiver: opspilot
  repeat_interval: 1h
  routes:
  - matchers:
    - opspilot_self="true"
    receiver: opspilot-self
templates: []
"}

{"relay":"connectors:
  spanmetrics: {}
exporters:
  debug: {}
  opensearch:
    http:
      endpoint: http://opensearch:9200
      tls:
        insecure: true
    logs_index: otel
  otlp:
    endpoint: jaeger-collector:4317
    tls:
      insecure: true
  otlphttp/prometheus:
    auth:[REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]      authenticator: basicauth/prometheus
    endpoint: http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/otlp
    tls:
      insecure: true
extensions:
  basicauth/prometheus:
    client_auth:[REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]      password: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]      username: collector
  health_check:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:13133
processors:
  batch: {}
  k8sattributes:
    extract:
      metadata:
      - k8s.namespace.name
      - k8s.deployment.name
      - k8s.statefulset.name
      - k8s.daemonset.name
      - k8s.cronjob.name
      - k8s.job.name
      - k8s.node.name
      - k8s.pod.name
      - k8s.pod.uid
      - k8s.pod.start_time
    passthrough: false
    pod_association:
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.ip
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.uid
    - sources:
      - from: connection
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 5s
    limit_percentage: 80
    spike_limit_percentage: 25
  resource:
    attributes:
    - action: insert
      from_attribute: k8s.pod.uid
      key: service.instance.id
  transform:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_statements:
    - context: span
      statements:
      - replace_pattern(name, "\\?.*", "")
      - replace_match(name, "GET /api/products/*", "GET /api/products/{productId}")
receivers:
  httpcheck/frontend-proxy:
    targets:
    - endpoint: http://frontend-proxy:8080
  jaeger:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14250
      thrift_compact:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:6831
      thrift_http:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14268
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4317
      http:
        cors:
          allowed_origins:
          - http://*
          - https://*
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4318
  prometheus:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
      - job_name: opentelemetry-collector
        scrape_interval: 10s
        static_configs:
        - targets:
          - ${env:MY_POD_IP}:8888
  redis:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: valkey-cart:6379
  zipkin:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:9411
service:
  extensions:
  - health_check
  - basicauth/prometheus
  pipelines:
    logs:
      exporters:
      - debug
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
    metrics:
      exporters:
      - otlphttp/prometheus
      - debug
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - httpcheck/frontend-proxy
      - redis
      - otlp
      - spanmetrics
    traces:
      exporters:
      - otlp
      - debug
      - spanmetrics
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resource
      - transform
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
      - jaeger
      - zipkin
  telemetry:
    metrics:
      level: detailed
      readers:
      - periodic:
          exporter:
            otlp:
              endpoint: otel-collector:4318
              protocol: grpc
          interval: 10000
          timeout: 5000
"}

{"alerting_rules.yml":"groups:
- name: opspilot-lab
  rules:
  - alert: CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh
    annotations:
      description: '{{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of checkout PlaceOrder server
        spans ended in error over the last 5 minutes.'
      summary: checkout PlaceOrder error ratio above 50%
    expr: |
      label_replace(label_replace(
        (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])))
        /
        (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder"}[5m])))
      , "namespace", "$1", "k8s_namespace_name", "(.*)"), "service", "$1", "service_name", "(.*)")
      > 0.5
    for: 2m
    labels:
      cluster: opspilot-m1
      opspilot_integration_id: m0-otel-20260909
      severity: critical
- name: opspilot-self
  rules:
  - alert: OpsPilotAgentAbsent
    annotations:
      description: role {{ $labels.role }} ({{ $labels.instance }}) has not answered
        /metrics for 2 minutes.
      summary: an OpsPilot health listener is down or the worker is not scraped
    expr: up{job="opspilot"} == 0 or absent(up{job="opspilot",role="worker"})
    for: 2m
    labels:
      opspilot_self: "true"
      severity: critical
  - alert: OpsPilotModelCallsFailing
    annotations:
      description: '{{ $value }} consecutive model calls failed on {{ $labels.instance
        }}.'
      summary: OpsPilot model calls are failing
    expr: opspilot_model_consecutive_failures >= 2
    for: 1m
    labels:
      opspilot_self: "true"
      severity: critical
","alerts":"{}
","allow-snippet-annotations":"false","prometheus.yml":"global:
  evaluation_interval: 1m
  scrape_interval: 1m
  scrape_timeout: 10s
storage:
  tsdb:
    out_of_order_time_window: 30m
otlp:
    keep_identifying_resource_attributes: true
    promote_resource_attributes:
    - opspilot.integration.id
    - service.instance.id
    - service.name
    - service.namespace
    - service.version
    - cloud.availability_zone
    - cloud.region
    - deployment.environment.name
    - k8s.cluster.name
    - k8s.container.name
    - k8s.cronjob.name
    - k8s.daemonset.name
    - k8s.deployment.name
    - k8s.job.name
    - k8s.namespace.name
    - k8s.node.name
    - k8s.pod.name
    - k8s.replicaset.name
    - k8s.statefulset.name
    - container.name
    - host.name
rule_files:
- /etc/config/recording_rules.yml
- /etc/config/alerting_rules.yml
- /etc/config/rules
- /etc/config/alerts
scrape_configs:
- job_name: prometheus
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - localhost:9090
- bearer_token_file: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]  job_name: kubernetes-apiservers
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: endpoints
  relabel_configs:
  - action: keep
    regex: default;kubernetes;https
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_namespace
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_name
    - __meta_kubernetes_endpoint_port_name
  scheme: https
  tls_config:
    ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
- bearer_token_file: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]  job_name: kubernetes-nodes
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: node
  relabel_configs:
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_node_label_(.+)
  - replacement: kubernetes.default.svc:443
    target_label: __address__
  - regex: (.+)
    replacement: /api/v1/nodes/$1/proxy/metrics
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_node_name
    target_label: __metrics_path__
  scheme: https
  tls_config:
    ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
- bearer_token_file: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]  job_name: kubernetes-nodes-cadvisor
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: node
  relabel_configs:
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_node_label_(.+)
  - replacement: kubernetes.default.svc:443
    target_label: __address__
  - regex: (.+)
    replacement: /api/v1/nodes/$1/proxy/metrics/cadvisor
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_node_name
    target_label: __metrics_path__
  scheme: https
  tls_config:
    ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
- honor_labels: true
  job_name: kubernetes-service-endpoints
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: endpoints
  relabel_configs:
  - action: keep
    regex: true
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape
  - action: drop
    regex: true
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape_slow
  - action: replace
    regex: (https?)
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_scheme
    target_label: __scheme__
  - action: replace
    regex: (.+)
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_path
    target_label: __metrics_path__
  - action: replace
    regex: (.+?)(?::\d+)?;(\d+)
    replacement: $1:$2
    source_labels:
    - __address__
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_port
    target_label: __address__
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_param_(.+)
    replacement: __param_$1
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_service_label_(.+)
  - action: replace
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_namespace
    target_label: namespace
  - action: replace
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_name
    target_label: service
  - action: replace
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_pod_node_name
    target_label: node
- honor_labels: true
  job_name: kubernetes-service-endpoints-slow
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: endpoints
  relabel_configs:
  - action: keep
    regex: true
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape_slow
  - action: replace
    regex: (https?)
    source_labels:
